original_value: Compact wired mechanical keyboard designed for office and creative workstations, featuring hot-swappable low-profile switches, per-key RGB lighting, a detachable USB-C cable, and a CNC aluminum frame. Includes a programmable rotary dial, Mac/Windows layer support, and a 75% layout optimized for desk efficiency.
